description: This file defines the ScopeRepository class implementing OAuth2 scope retrieval and management, including scope definitions and methods to retrieve scope entities by identifier within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 API module.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 scope retrieval and management for SuiteCRM, providing methods to get scope entities by identifier and finalize scopes for OAuth2 grant types.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a scope entity based on its identifier, creating a new ScopeEntity with the identifier if it exists in predefined scopes.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes scope selection during OAuth2 token issuance; currently returns the provided scopes unchanged.
